title: Term 1 and 2 Examination
instructions: This paper covers the work of Terms 1 and 2.
This question paper consists of 5 questions. Answer ALL the questions.
Read each question carefully before you answer it.

sections.title: QUESTION 2: Coping with Stress and Emotions

questions.prompt: Which is a HEALTHY way to cope with stress?
What is the ability to bounce back after difficult experiences called?

Classify each coping strategy.
Describe THREE steps to manage anger in a healthy way.
questions.memo: Any three (1 each): stop and breathe deeply; count to ten; walk away to cool down; exercise; talk calmly using I-statements later; find solutions

pairs.right: Starving oneself from a fear of gaining weight
Excess body weight from taking in more energy than is used

questions.prompt: You notice that a friend skips lunch every day, has lost a lot of weight and says she is 'too fat'. Explain what this might be and describe how you could help her.
questions.memo:
✓ identifies possible anorexia / an eating disorder (1)
✓ talk to her privately and kindly, without blaming or judging (1)
✓ encourage her to speak to a trusted adult, school nurse, counsellor or clinic / SADAG (1)
✓ tell a trusted adult yourself if she will not, because it can be life-threatening; avoid comments about weight (1)
